milestone: Bounded GPU expert cache reservations and pinned leases
status: Qualified component; whole inference goal remains active

implementation.cache: Existing GPU MoE cache now supports pre-allocation reservations, transactional publication, generation-checked leases, pinned-entry eviction protection, abort, and busy close.
implementation.ownership: Backend model owns immutable weights; consumers release leases only after queued GPU use completes. Serialized cache access required.
implementation.upload_ordering: Cold trellis weight construction explicitly waits for default-stream upload completion before publication.
implementation.compatibility: Legacy lookup remains an unpinned synchronous borrow. Legacy insert allocates before admission and does not establish a transient bound; bounded callers must reserve first. Bridge admission failures now retain temporary ownership or clean up.

limitations: Compressed-weight payload bound excludes context, library allocations, request tensors/workspace, host cache and host staging.
Actual checkpoint tests use deterministic FFN inputs and frozen independent references; full model routing and generation are not connected.
Host RAM selected-expert cache statistics exclude the replacement expert read through a separate bounded staging buffer.
Storage coldness was not controlled; trace timing is diagnostic, not a performance or vLLM parity result.
Model-level scheduling, completion-driven lease management, separate prefill staging policy, and asynchronous upload remain to integrate.
